scope: Factual social detector and post-installation experience ledger only

conceptual_framework.summary: Social-homeostasis frameworks distinguish detection of social contact from an individual set-point, comparison/error process and behavioural effectors. Quantity and quality are distinct; individual and acute/chronic conditions matter.
conceptual_framework.claim_limit: The references do not provide a universal quantitative equation for human loneliness, and this implementation does not invent one.

references.citation: Matthews GA, Tye KM. Neural mechanisms of social homeostasis. Ann N Y Acad Sci. 2019;1457(1):5-25.
Lee CR, Chen A, Tye KM. The neural circuitry of social homeostasis: Consequences of acute versus chronic social isolation. Cell. 2021;184(6):1500-1516.

semantics.quality_provenance: Explicit structured world facts or deterministic implemented world branches only
semantics.opportunity_contact_distinction: An opportunity is retained even when no reciprocal contact occurs
semantics.rejection: REJECTED requires explicit refusal or ignoring; absent evidence remains UNKNOWN or NO_RESPONSE
semantics.postcards: Arrival is one-way MESSAGE_RECEIVED with UNKNOWN character. A reply may make the mediated episode RECIPROCAL without making it SUPPORTIVE.
semantics.observation_gaps: Runner downtime is recorded as unknown observation continuity and never inferred as isolation
semantics.confirmed_isolation: Requires explicit continuous observation, aloneness and no contact

legacy_exclusions: cast warmth, suspicion or grudge scalars
legacy Loneliness baseline, impulses, decay and elapsed-time clock

engineering_numbers.use: recent episode transport bound in frequent vitals snapshots; complete history remains in persisted state and environment-event storage
engineering_numbers.classification: ARBITRARY DISPLAY / TRANSPORT LIMIT, NOT PSYCHOLOGICAL

not_modelled: subjective Loneliness or other emotional interpretation of facts supplied to the language model
public_notes_principle: Cy's brain display is deliberately a functional analogy, not a fake brain scan. Real psychological and bodily processes are distributed across interacting systems, so the project avoids inventing single 'centres' or precise-looking activation where the model does not justify one.
